stem: What is the key fluid abnormality in hypernatraemic dehydration?

options.text: Water deficit greater than sodium deficit
Sodium deficit greater than water deficit
Normal total body sodium and water

explanation: Hypernatraemic dehydration occurs when water loss exceeds sodium loss, causing an elevated serum sodium concentration. Fluid correction must be cautious to avoid rapid shifts.
